issue: Discovery sweep of France (rings A-D: CRE/GRTgaz/EU-PCI regulators, EN+FR trade press, Elengy/TotalEnergies sponsor IR, FSRU orderbook/charters) found ZERO LNG import or export terminals missing from GEM. France's GEM coverage (7 terminals / 13 unit-rows: Dunkirk, Fos Cavaou, Fos Tonkin, Montoir operating; Le Havre FSRU operating; Fos Lavera Marseille and Le Havre-Antifer cancelled) is comprehensive. Every lead surfaced (Le Havre FSRU, Dunkirk small-scale/bunkering expansion, Fos Cavaou Expansion 2, Montoir Expansion) maps to an existing GEM record. Le Havre FSRU (FSRU Cape Ann, ex-Hoegh, chartered by TotalEnergies, operating since 26-Oct-2023) is already in GEM (TID T100000131008) and was the most recent genuinely-new French entry point.
suggested_action: No discovery additions for France this batch (expected for a mature, fully-covered importer). Next batch: re-check CRE/GRTgaz capacity tenders and the next ENTSOG TYNDP / EU PCI cycle for any new entry-point proposal; no current lead warrants a monitor entry.

terminal_name: France - out-of-scope forward gas-infrastructure (not LNG terminals)
issue: Forward French gas-infrastructure activity surfaced by the sweep is NOT LNG-terminal scope and was NOT staged: (1) Dunkirk CO2 export terminal (GOCO2 / CO2 liquefaction-and-ship next to Dunkirk LNG, FID targeted ~2025) is a carbon-capture export project, not an LNG terminal; (2) Elengy 'projects in the making' are bioLNG-by-equivalence liquefaction service, hydrogen, and CCUS/Rhone Decarbonation at existing sites, not new terminals; (3) Geomethane (Manosque) is an underground salt-cavern natural-gas storage facility (Storengy/Geostock), not an LNG facility. Documented so the next discovery batch does not re-hunt these as LNG leads.
suggested_action: No action. These are tracked here only as dedup/out-of-scope notes. CO2/H2/CCUS projects belong to other GEM trackers if at all; bioLNG service offerings are not separate terminals.

issue: Discovery cross-check on the existing Le Havre FSRU (NOT a new gap): TotalEnergies/TELSF ran a CRE-approved binding capacity tender (23 TWh/yr, Jan-2026 to Sep-2028, marketing window 14-Jul to 20-Aug-2025) WHILE simultaneously announcing demobilization of the FSRU Cape Ann (terminal idle since the Jun-2024 last cargo; uninstall ordered before 18-Dec-2025 per administrative-court decision). The two facts coexist in current sources and could read as conflicting. No new terminal or new entry point arises from this; the operating-status change is the UPDATE agent's domain (already logged) - flagged here only to confirm discovery found no second/replacement French entry point behind the tender.
suggested_action: No discovery add. Defer the operating/demobilization status handling to the concurrent France UPDATE pass (status_timeline; fetch_timeline DOWN). Discovery confirms the tender does not imply a new or additional French terminal.
